## Requirements (§6.3 C1 + §5h.3 C1)

Engine (R-2.10.3 C1): multi-worker `claim` over scoped leases (landed S3.4a —
verified), `Pool{key, limit ≤ max_concurrent_runs}` enforcement at
`next`/`claim`/`launch` with `PoolExhausted`, `pool_consumed`/`pool_released`
instrumentation, `max_concurrent_runs` cap, `start_stagger_ms`,
`pause`/`resume` with probe tags (landed — tags added), bounded re-attempts
(landed), hosted levels (`launch` through a `HostedLauncher` SPI —
`hh-hosting`-free so the hosting tier stays removable; `participant_class =
hosted` + `limits_enforced` stamps; `component-level` hosted factors refuse
`InadmissibleFactor` at `register`; `configuration-level` is capability-gated),
`close` → `bundle(kind = experiment)` at the boundary, the three Phase-4
recipes registered + run under `matched_total`.

Bundle (R-2.9.3 C1): `arm`/`experiment`/`lineage` kinds composing by
`version_id`, S8 policy rows (`ReaderViolation`/`ConsentMissing`) + S9
cross-section, `ReproReport{independent}`, `BundleStatusRecord` +
`set_status`/`status` with the monotone ladder (`validated` ← valid report;
`attested` ← attestation on the manifest `version_id`; `reproduced` ←
independent ReproReport), `supersede_bundle`/`lineage`, `migrate_bundle`,
`attest`/`audit_bundle`, `PublicationPolicy` + `export` (targets
`harbor_job_dir`, `interchange_trajectory` at product granularity + loss
listing, `swebench_submission`, `inspect_eval_log`, `in_toto_bundle`,
`telemetry_trace` — last four deferred DF-S4.2-2), foreign `import`
(`harbor_trial_dir`, `harbor_job_dir` → hosted bundles + ImportRecord +
MappingReport + LossReport; the rest DF-S4.2-2), `diff` → `ManifestDiff`,
`fetch` pool-backed materialisation (remote transports →
`Refused{transport_pending}`, DF-S4.2-1), `reproduce(bundle, R2, n ≥ 3)` live arm —
instrument-charged side-runs, seed material recorded, outcome-distribution
compare on the named validator set + end-state class within the
pre-registered margin; `min_bundle_status` gating exercised (the leaderboard
`min_status` admission reads catalogue status — `attested`/`reproduced` become
reachable only through `set_status` records).

## Boundary decisions (owned — ADR written)

- `lab.producer.{declare,bind,record_analysis}` stay pending: §06.5's producer
  contract for *external* producers is the results-store slice (S4.3 owns the
  `AnalysisRecord` half; imported experiment runs are C2). `exclude`/`amend`
  are engine verbs — exposed as `lab.producer.exclude`/`lab.producer.amend`.
- `kernel.bundle` gains `kind` ∈ {run, arm, experiment, lineage} + scope
  params (`experiment_run_id`, `arm_id`, `lineage_root`) — additive.
- `close` → bundle composition lives at the boundary (`lab.experiment.close`
  assembles via `hh-bundle`, then `record_bundle`) — keeps `hh-experiment` free
  of an `hh-bundle` edge.
- `fetch` lands pool-backed: `locations[]`/digest members materialise
  `bundle/` + `pool/` from the blob pool; remote transports refuse
  `Refused{transport_pending}` — DF-S4.2-1 (WS-L6 trust fields spec-parked).
- `ArmSpec.inference_budget: Option<ContentAddress>` — additive M3 third
  term; `None` = unconstrained, never zero.
- S9 `results.arm` is required on `kind = arm` only; `run`-scoped bundles
  check `declaration.members[]` + `run_id` capture.
- `superseded` reachable from every state (the spec's "terminal" describes
  the destination); `retracted` unreachable from `superseded`.
- `kernel.import` general head: `ledger_native` → decoded-bundle `lift`;
  foreign formats → `lift_foreign` over `{path|files[]}` + hosted/
  `unverified` receipts. Full rulings: ADR-0293.
